messages:
maria: Quick thread: finalizing migration note for v1->v2. Two outstanding items: exact deprecation header name + sample SDK fallback behavior. I put a draft in staging: https://redwood.dev/r/4301

ryan: let's standardize on `X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1` so it's explicit to our infra. Also include `Retry-After` for rate-limited deprecations?

tess: I'll update the Python and Go snippets. Proposal: show both `apiVersion: 'v2'` and `compat: true` usage, with a comment that compat is temporary and logs a warning.

infra-bot: Notice: staging deploy succeeded for docs-staging (build 1152).

maria: sample curl I added (shows header):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 307 Temporary Redirect
#    Location: /v2/models
#    X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1
```
Include in migration guide under "server behavior" section.

ryan: For SDKs: compat mode should translate body keys when possible, and emit a console warn / log. Keep translation simple: `model` -> `model:` if user passed string. Document edge cases where translation cannot infer typed fields.

maria: good. Also adding a short paragraph for Console quickstarts to call out hardcoded endpoints. Can someone grep the repo for `/v1/models`?

tess: on it. I'll send a PR to update examples and leave a note to add redirect rules in our infra repo.

infra-bot: grep results: 7 occurrences of "/v1/models" in quickstarts and examples.

maria: assign owners: @ryan for header naming + SDK warning text, @tess for snippets + quickstart edits, infra to add redirect rules. I'll schedule a 10m wrap-up tomorrow.

docs-bot: Migration doc PR #4301 created by @maria. Please review.

ryan: one more: add rollout timeline and date placeholder. We'll not cut the sunset date until infra confirms redirects live.

maria: noted. Thanks team.
